mission: Hostile falsification of the proposed economized V550 conditional architecture: determine whether replacing the broad determinicity suite with sparse governed conditional empirical evidence loses terminal meaning, future capability, plurality, uncertainty, provenance, or negative authority.
scope_notes: No sibling VT3-CM result was used.
The court adjudicates semantic no-loss requirements and does not redesign the replacement architecture beyond the minimum requirements exposed by failed fixtures.

evidence_ledger.finding: Requires historical causality without inevitability, contradiction/multiplicity, structural-prior/psyche separation, typed absence/uncertainty, and minimum sufficient machinery without deleting meaningful distinctions.
Requires preservation of conditions, temporal applicability, contradiction, provenance, negative authority, direct DAG reuse, and no-starvation proof.
Requires minimum sufficient architecture, direct reuse of earlier authority where lawful, and removal/demotion of objects that lack a no-starvation justification.

The indicator-answer matrix preserves full unary condition-response contingency rows; summary metrics are derived; secondary gain uses pairwise joint keys; branches are greedy/depth/support/top-two bounded; outliers are support-gated dominant-response classifications.
Current scalar association/entropy metrics are deterministic functions of contingency/support data; normalized MI and Cramer's V are implemented as unweighted functions.

Maps indicator_answer_matrix/outlier/secondary/recursive artifacts to derived_determinicity; position surfaces to position_context; underpowered_quarantine to audit_quarantine; cloud/co-signature surfaces to disabled_artifact.
Current conditional compiler excludes evidence whose support state is not sufficient_support; emitted conditional row does not expose conditioning field/value as first-class condition identity.
Support states distinguish zero_support, underpowered, sufficient_support, missing_support/not_applicable; default support threshold uses rate 0.005, floor 2, cap 30.
Position prevalence is respondent-derived and preserves unweighted and, when valid, weighted counts/shares; semantic role is POSITION_COORDINATE.

Current co-execution substrate preserves respondent IDs, source/wave/country, response values/semantics/special states, weights, authority/use fields, and base/joint selection metadata, demonstrating an existing respondent-grain recomputation class.
Joint-pattern machinery preserves joint evidence, support, association lanes and publishability/review distinctions; marginal conditionals are not sufficient for all governed joint evidence.
Joint execution is explicitly authority-gated by executable registry status and accepted authority release IDs.
Tests distinguish VALID_EMPTY, PRESENT+DENY, PRESENT+ALLOW, and unresolved/integrity failure; retention and downstream permission are distinct states.
Requires producer-preserving reference closure, typed negative authority, progressive runtime position binding, and forbids resolver invention of actor positions.
Freezes STRUCTURAL PRIOR != ACTOR FACT, simultaneous contradictory pressure streams, generated positions, and prohibition on prevalence-to-membership inference.
Positions are time-indexed generated actor facts; multiple independent position facts may coexist; raw prevalence/demographic association cannot create actor membership or probability.

findings.summary: The semantic core is distributional, not scalar: full condition-value x response support must survive; MI/Cramer's V, dominant response and entropy-gain summaries are insufficient substitutes.
Unary conditionals are not lossless. XOR/intersection and Simpson-reversal fixtures require governed multi-predicate condition identity or reconstructible joint evidence.
Support eligibility cannot be used as the canonical storage gate. Underpowered observed evidence is historically present even when downstream pressure/publication permission is DENY.
A positive distribution record cannot encode all lawful negative states; typed absence/noncomparability/unresolved/forbidden states are irreducible.
Weighted and unweighted distributions are distinct empirical facts and can reverse direction; both bases and denominator/weight provenance must survive.
Conditional empirical association cannot generate actor position, identity, belief or psyche. V3 matching occurs only after separately governed generated position facts exist.
Future authority admitting a currently unused condition cannot be supported from today's sparse marginals alone; respondent-level reconstructibility or exact immutable source reference is required.
The existing recursive branch tree is an exploratory heuristic, not lossless population ontology: it is greedy, bounded-depth, support-gated and follows only the two most frequent split values.

No current MI/Cramer's-V, outlier, secondary-gain or recursive-branch artifact shape is irreducible as terminal semantic authority if the underlying sufficient statistics and recomputation substrate remain available.

irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.name: GOVERNED_CONDITION_SET_IDENTITY
irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.minimum_requirement: Exact zero/one/multi-predicate condition identity with stable field/value authority and source-wave scope.

irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.name: TYPED_CONDITIONAL_EVIDENCE_LIMIT_OR_NEGATIVE_STATE
irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.minimum_requirement: Represent missing variable, not asked, valid-empty, zero/underpowered support, unresolved/missing authority, noncomparability, denial and forbidden inference without relying on absence of row.

irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.name: RESPONDENT_LEVEL_RECOMPUTATION_AUTHORITY_OR_EXACT_REFERENCE
irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.minimum_requirement: Stable respondent joins with response, condition variables, weights/special states and provenance, or exact immutable access to equivalent authoritative source material.

irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.name: EPISTEMIC_AND_USE_PERMISSION_BOUNDARY
irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.minimum_requirement: Conditional empirical evidence remains source evidence/structural prior and cannot become generated actor position, identity, belief, psyche, history or expression.

irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.name: WEIGHT_AND_DENOMINATOR_BASIS
irreducible_missing_objects_or_dimension.minimum_requirement: Preserve both weighted and unweighted counts/shares with exact denominator and weight status/provenance.

diagnostic_semantics_that_must_survive: Low-support observed evidence must survive as typed evidence state even if underpowered_quarantine disappears.
Joint/respondent evidence needed to regenerate secondary-gain and recursive-branch diagnostics must remain reconstructible even if those diagnostics disappear.

counterevidence.claim: Outlier summaries may surface historically significant minorities.
counterevidence.reason: The underlying subgroup distribution with typed support is strictly richer; current outlier logic suppresses low-support cells.

counterevidence.claim: Secondary gain discovers interactions not visible in unary conditionals.
counterevidence.reason: Joint conditionals/respondent evidence preserve the interaction; the selective summary is regenerable.
The current tree omits alternative splits and rare categories; respondent-level joint evidence is the no-loss substrate.

counterevidence.claim: Position prevalence could later be used in actor generation.
counterevidence.reason: ADP-009 requires separately governed distribution authority and explicitly forbids raw prevalence to actor membership/probability.

unresolved_questions: The exact sibling VT3-CM-R06 proposed schema is not present on the shared launch base; R00/Vozhd Trii must compare it field-by-field against C1-C5.
The final physical retention mechanism for respondent-level recomputability is not decided by R07.

If future authority requires design-based survey uncertainty using PSU/strata/cluster variables, current V550 conditional summaries and the observed shared-substrate required columns may not be sufficient; this is an existing/future-authority question rather than a reason to retain current diagnostics.
R07 does not decide whether typed conditional limit/negative states are embedded in the distribution family or published as a companion object.
Cross-source condition/value harmonization requires separate governed comparability authority; same labels are not assumed equivalent.
R07 proves conjunction representability/reconstructibility but does not authorize unrestricted Cartesian precomputation or choose a joint-materialization policy.
recommended_parent_actions: Compare R06 against C1-C5; any missing requirement is a no-loss failure.
Forbid support gating as evidence deletion; preserve low-support evidence with restricted downstream permission.
Require governed conjunction identity and future joint reconstructibility; reject unary-only terminal sufficiency.
Demote MI/Cramer's V, outlier, secondary-gain and recursive-branch outputs to recomputable diagnostics unless another authority establishes a distinct semantic consumer.
Preserve baseline distributions, complete response topology, source/wave/question/response-semantics provenance, and both weighted/unweighted sufficient statistics.
Preserve respondent-level authoritative recomputation access; if intentionally removed, change the architecture verdict to SEMANTIC_LOSS.
Preserve the V3/ADP-009 structural-prior != actor-fact boundary and allow multiple simultaneous applicable conditional evidence objects without forced scalar collapse.

lossless_if: C1 governed condition-set identity is present
C2 typed conditional negative/limit states are present
C4 epistemic/use permission boundary is explicit
full response distributions and exact source/wave/question/response-semantic provenance survive
semantic_loss_if: absence/noncomparability is represented only by missing rows
conditional association is allowed to become actor identity/belief
weighted or unweighted basis is silently discarded
